commit.message:
Fix the caret landing one character off in multi-line plain text boxes (#8887)

# Description of Changes

- Putting the caret back in a multi-line text box that is painted as
plain text (no exact layout, such as a bulleted list) now lands on the
right character. It counted only the text and not the line breaks, so on
the second line it was one character off and past the end of the last
line it jumped to the start of the box
- The editor puts the caret back this way whenever it repaints a focused
box, for example after an undo while typing
- Found by the text editor regression harness on a WeasyPrint PDF with a
bulleted list
- Verified on this branch in a browser build (Chromium, macOS): every
caret position in that list round-trips, and typing at the end of the
list stays at the end
- New unit test round-trips every offset of multi-line plain text; it
fails on main
- Ran `task frontend:check`, not the full `task check`

---

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
* Improved caret positioning in plain text containing line breaks,
including when moving to the start of a new line or the end of the text.
Positioning now stays consistent across consecutive, leading, and
trailing breaks, as well as text mixed with inline or block content.
* Caret positions now round-trip consistently through bullet-prefixed
lines, nested and empty blocks, and content with leading or trailing
breaks.
